changes.before: These are not general exemptions from every property tax. [Registration arts. 14–15](https://amategeko.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/BOB_No2BIS-2020.pdf).
changes.after: These principal registration exemptions do not by themselves exempt every property tax. A separate 2026 budget overlay exempts **gifts granted to the State and its administrative subdivisions from all taxes, duties and charges**: January art. 207 applies in the first period and July art. 226 in the second. Confirm both the gift and qualifying beneficiary; this does not make an ordinary purchase exempt from all taxes or extend that gift rule to every religious/scientific/philanthropic body. Do not equate an administrative public establishment with an administrative subdivision without confirming its legal status. [Registration arts. 14–15](https://amategeko.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/BOB_No2BIS-2020.pdf); [January art. 207](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [July art. 226](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).

**Separate weekly notary/public-officer reporting:** at the end of each week, without undue delay, the notary or public officer who authenticated or signed a transfer, mortgage-constitution or other real-property-right act sends the territorially competent registrar the list of those acts. Include the parties’ names and given names or business names; act number and object; total transaction price stipulated in the deed; parcel location; cadastral or parcel number; and title number if any. This is separate from the parties’ transfer-notification deadline below. [Registration art. 23, continuation](https://amategeko.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/BOB_No2BIS-2020.pdf).

[January art. 139](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [July art. 147](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).
changes.after: 7. **If building an urban house:** obtain the prior building authorisation and approved estimate, pay the building tax, then display the authorisation reference and proof of tax payment on the site. The separate permit-insurance clauses make grant of the building permit conditional on an insurance certificate covering damage to the works and decennial and biennial liability **when the value of the work to be built is estimated at BIF 100,000,000**. The exact legislative condition is « lorsque la valeur de l’ouvrage à construire est estimée à cent millions »; it does not say “at least”. Do not invent a >= threshold or conclude that other estimates are exempt. Its broader application, current required insurance evidence and permit implementation remain held. This is distinct from the fire-insurance certificate for a built-property title transfer. Read the applicable implementing order before an actual permit request. [January arts. 139, 215](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [July arts. 147, 235](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).

## Penalties and interest

- Refusal or delay in transmitting the separate weekly notary/public-officer list attracts **BIF 50,000 per untransmitted act plus 1% of duties due per week late**. Apply this art. 23 sanction to that reporting duty, separately from the parties’ art. 24 transfer-notification charge. [Registration art. 23, continuation](https://amategeko.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/BOB_No2BIS-2020.pdf).
